description: The op-4542 Wakao exponent fix landed in tuas_boussinesq_solver on 2026-08-11 (WakaoData::get() now computes the published Nu = 2 + 1.1 Pr^(1/3) Re^0.6). crates/tampines/src/pebble_bed/mod.rs still describes the TUAS defect as 'Warning, still current', and crates/tampines/src/pebble_bed/cht.rs says 'Do not unify the two until op-4542 is closed' and carries a divergence_from_the_tuas_wakao_implementation test pinning the ~5.8x divergence (independently reproduced: 5.8475 at Re=1000, Pr=0.7). Once op-4542 is closed by the maintainer, these warnings and the divergence test need updating (the divergence test will presumably now FAIL or need repurposing since the two implementations agree). NOT fixed during the op-4542 fleet because a sibling fleet was live in crates/tampines/ -- deliberately left to the tampines owners. Blocked on maintainer closing op-4542.
title: tampines: pebble_bed cht.rs/mod.rs carry now-stale 'TUAS Wakao defect still current' warnings after op-4542 fix
